builds.title: pytest markers for feature-area test filtering
builds.summary: User request: tests/ has grown to 79 phase-scoped files (AI_START_HERE.md's documented convention: one file per build/contract, for direct traceability from a phase doc's Evidence section or a build_history.json entry to the exact regression it introduced). Reorganizing by feature area was considered and explicitly recommended against -- it would break that traceability link across every prior build for a purely organizational change. Instead, new pytest.ini registers 7 feature-area markers (inventory, configuration, compliance, discovery, render, runtime_platform, security) and every test file gets exactly one module-level `pytestmark` line mapping it to its area -- purely additive, zero file moves, zero logic touched. `pytest -m compliance` now runs a 104-test feature slice instead of the full 639; all 7 markers partition the suite with no gaps or overlaps (68+188+104+165+11+59+44=639).

evidence.automated: Caught and fixed two files where the marker's insertion point ended up before an existing (but non-top-of-file) `import pytest`, which would have raised a NameError at collection time -- found via a full ast-based line-order check across all 79 files after the initial pass, not assumed safe. `git diff` confirms every changed line across the 79 files is only an inserted `import pytest` / `pytestmark = ...` / blank line -- no other line touched. `pytest --collect-only`: 639 tests collected, zero warnings, zero errors (matches the pre-change count exactly). `pytest -q`: 635 passed, 2 skipped, 2 failed (both pre-existing and unrelated, same two tests already documented against the unmodified baseline in every prior 0.6.x closure this session). Zero regressions.

builds.title: Playwright/Chromium fallback for the HTML render harness's DOM-execution check

builds.title: HTML export render hotfix (dead module-nav buttons)
builds.summary: P0: on a real run the report rendered but every module-nav button was dead, stuck on Overview. Cause: html_export filled the template with a SEQUENCE of str.replace() calls; project/backlog.json + project/build_history.json contain the literal token __CRYPTO_JSON_PLACEHOLDER__ in a note, so once projectPlanData was embedded the later replace() spliced the crypto JSON object into the middle of that JS string literal -> SyntaxError -> the whole inline <script> never ran -> no event listeners. Fix: utils/html_export._fill_template does one left-to-right pass (single re alternation, longest key first, function replacement) so inserted content is never re-scanned; run_html_export calls it once for all eight sentinels. _script_json unchanged.
